references.text: The prophecy about the Messiah being divided between two others may reflect the request to sit at Jesus' sides in his glory.
David's psalm about the Lord's promise and victory can be seen as a precursor to the concept of sitting at God's right hand.
A parallel event where Jesus' disciples ask for positions in his kingdom, which points back to Mark 10:37.
Jesus' promise of kingdoms and thrones to his disciples may relate to the request to sit at his sides.
